methodology.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95; raw samples retained.
methodology.cold: Fresh service/page/module workloads; OS disk caches are not flushed.
methodology.browser: Production React bundle; synthetic Git host to isolate UI cost. Native-host Git costs measured separately.
methodology.nativeHost: Actual plugin bundle through an Obsidian API shim; metadata serialization writes a real temporary file.
methodology.thresholds: Targets for this audit, not universal guarantees. Browser timings include two animation frames and wait for deferred content intersecting the visible scroll viewport; background prefetch outside it is excluded.

metrics.name: git.mutation.apply-index
metrics.includes: hard reset before and after apply, confined to the disposable fixture repository

metrics.name: git.list.1000-reflog-entries
metrics.note: UI 1000-stash workload uses distinct hashes; Git load here measures reflog volume.

coverage: Patch parsing, tree build/filter/flatten, full context, syntax cold/warm/cache churn/large fallback, inline diff, metadata load/clone/serialize/export, Markdown targets.
Real Windows Git: repository resolve/status, stash list up to 1000 entries, all/staged/unstaged diffs, full source, create/apply/drop/undo, duplicate reads across six embeds, native metadata writes.

Production browser: initial paint, layer/layout/scope switching, stash/file search, navigation, full context, collapse, annotation save/resolve, viewed progress, clipboard/Markdown/export, six embeds, repeated mount/unmount and heap, 1x/4x CPU.
